ValidationRule.description: No one apart from Capability & Quality (C&Q) Team can create "C&Q Assessment" Assessment records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'C_Q_Assessment', $UserRole.DeveloperName != 'Capability_Quality_C_Q_Team' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: No one apart from Capability & Quality (C&Q) Team can create "C&Q Assessment" Assessment records.
